column6: He has sprouted, he has burgeoned, he is well-watered lettuce, my shaded garden of the desert, richly flourishing, @varh[t40805.v1]{his mother's favourite } @vart[t40805.v2,t40805.v1]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} he is well-watered lettuce }; my grain lovely in beauty in its furrows, he is well-watered lettuce; my first-class fruitful apple tree, he is well-watered lettuce.

The honey man, the honey man will make me sweet; my lord, the honey man of a goddess, his mother's favourite, whose hands are honey, whose feet are honey, will make me sweet, whose limbs are honey-sweet, will make me sweet.
Navel! My altogether immediately sweet, my favourite of his mother! Beautiful thighs, raised arms! My ……, he is well-watered lettuce.
